# Conjecture & Refutations (conjecture.school)

> A weekly lecture series that brings Conjecture Institute to Network School, taught in public, recorded, and shipped.

Conjecture & Refutations is a nineteen-session lecture series run at Network School in Forest City, covering critical rationalism (Deutsch and Popper), Austrian economics as error correction, and memetic money. Every lecture is treated as a conjecture open to refutation. Each session is taught live, recorded, and published, so the recordings act as the proof of work.

It is for the critical rationalist community and anyone at Network School who wants to think through how knowledge grows under criticism. The site is a single landing page that lists the next session, the series arc, the recordings ledger, the Conjecture Institute fellows, and the three co-curators. It is early: most episodes are still planned, and only Episode 01 (a David Deutsch overview) is live.

## Key links
- [Home](https://conjecture.school/): the series overview, next session RSVP, recordings ledger, and fellows list.
- [Watch](https://conjecture.school/#watch): the Episode 01 primer video on Deutsch's two books.
- [Recordings](https://conjecture.school/#recordings): the running ledger of published sessions.
- [Fellows](https://conjecture.school/#fellows): people extending the Popperian programme at Conjecture Institute.
- [Design](https://conjecture.school/design): the site's design system and tokens.
